info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchandising Loan Management API
info.description: The Merchandising Loan Management API allows businesses to efficiently update and manage the details of merchandising loans. This endpoint facilitates the partial modification of loan information, accommodating changes such as terms, amounts, or borrower details. Typical consumers include financial institutions and app developers seeking to integrate loan management capabilities into their platforms. The API supports streamlined interactions for better customer engagement and enhanced lending experiences.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific merchandising loan identified by its unique loan ID. Use this operation to modify relevant information about the loan as required by your business needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific merchandising loan identified by LOAN-500045. Please ensure that you provide the necessary fields to modify the loan details as required.

200.description: The update was successful and the resource is returned.
